stories.title: Burning smell across Flintshire this morning is coming from 150 miles away
stories.summary: The smell of smoke across Flintshire this morning is coming from wildfires burning in south Wales, North Wales Fire and Rescue Service has said. The service said its control room had taken a high volume of calls about the smoke and asked people not to tie up emergency lines unless they can see a fire.

stories.title: Solar eclipse over Deeside reaches maximum at 7.10pm on Wednesday
stories.summary: Ninety-two per cent of the sun will be covered over Deeside at 7.10pm on Wednesday, in the deepest solar eclipse seen from this part of Wales since 1999.
